notes.title: WHO SAYS WIRED VR CAN’T DASH?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45132899/711a8c7f82152b7605f75cd08484c5ed050296d2.png[/img]

Introducing 10 brand-new levels with 180° forward-facing gameplay—designed for all setups!

✅ [b]Original Levels[/b]
[list]
[*]Require 360° rotation, perfect for standalone VR players to dash freely in every direction.
[/list]
✅ [b]New Levels[/b]
[list]
[*]Only require 180° forward turning, ideal for tethered VR players to enjoy smooth gameplay even in limited space!
[/list]

🎮 Whether you're chasing top speed or prefer comfort, [b]Sportvida CyberDash[/b] offers the perfect way to play your way!

🚀 Everyone has their own track—run your way, your style!
🔥 Try it now in the Steam Demo!
󠀠
Add the game to your wishlist now and get ready for the official release on [b]May 20th[/b]! 🎮
